about: Path globs -> test areas for run_tests.ps1 -Changed (Tools/README_tests.md, 'Areas'). Paths are relative to the project, '/' separated, case-insensitive; '*' and '?' stay inside one folder, '**' crosses folders; a trailing '.meta' is ignored. Every entry that matches a path applies (union): 'areas' adds areas, 'rows' adds rows by id pattern (as -Only), 'shared': true also adds sharedAdds (shared HLSL, the catalog, motion stages -> character rendering and the all-card rows), 'all': true selects every row. 'ignore': true drops the path whatever else matches (documentation). An entry with no areas only marks the path as known. A changed path that no entry matches is reported as unmapped.
